individual-data-points.explanation: Spatial deconvolution plots are heatmap-style visualizations, which are exempt from needing individual data points.

error-bars-defined.explanation: Spatial heatmap plots show per-spot intensity values with no error bars, so nothing needs to be defined.

individual-data-points.explanation: Box plots already convey the data distribution and are exempt from the individual-points requirement; individual data points are additionally overlaid as dots.

error-bars-defined.from_the_caption: The box plots represent the distribution of values for each group, extending from the 25th percentile to the 75th percentile; T11b-high LUSC: Classical monocyte (minima=0.00035, median=0.32265, maxima=1, Q1 = 0.16193, Q3 = 0.52806)...
error-bars-defined.explanation: Box elements (quartiles) and whisker extremes (minima/maxima) for each group are explicitly reported in the caption.

individual-data-points.explanation: GSEA enrichment plots are line plots, which are exempt from the individual-points requirement.

error-bars-defined.explanation: The enrichment score line plots show no error bars, so nothing needs to be defined.

individual-data-points.explanation: Each bar shows a single computed log2 fold-change statistic from a differential gene expression analysis rather than a mean of replicate measurements, so individual data points are not applicable.

error-bars-defined.explanation: The bar graph shows log2 fold-change values with p-values labeled, but no error bars are present.

individual-data-points.explanation: Panel E consists of H&E and IHC micrographs, not a plot.

error-bars-defined.explanation: Panel E consists of micrographs, not a plot, so error bars do not apply.
